bookSourceComment: 来源：yolo52/Yuedu 轻小说.json，GPL-3.0，https://github.com/yolo52/Yuedu 。柘栯适配：修正搜索翻页；按站点卷册与章节行号生成目录；缓存分卷文本并保留插图。无账号、付费或验证码解锁。来源收录及卷册数量不代表全本完整性保证。

ruleToc.chapterList: @js:(function(){var data=JSON.parse(result); if(data.code!==200 || !data.results) throw new Error('卷目录请求失败'); var out=[]; data.results.list.forEach(function(v){var url='https://api.mangacopy.com/api/v3/book/'+v.book_path_word+'/volume/'+v.id+'?_update=true'; var r=JSON.parse(java.ajax(url)); if(r.code!==200 || !r.results || r.results.is_lock || !r.results.volume) throw new Error('卷册不可用：'+v.name); var entries=r.results.volume.contents; if(!entries || !entries.length) throw new Error('卷册目录为空：'+v.name); out.push({name:v.name,url:url,volume:true}); entries.forEach(function(c,i){out.push({name:c.name,url:url+'&part='+i,volume:false});});}); return out;})()

ruleContent.content: @js:(function(){var r=JSON.parse(result); if(r.code!==200 || !r.results || r.results.is_lock || !r.results.volume) throw new Error('卷册不可用'); var v=r.results.volume; var match=String(baseUrl).match(/[?&]part=(\d+)/); if(!match) throw new Error('章节位置缺失'); var c=v.contents[Number(match[1])]; if(!c) throw new Error('章节不存在'); if(c.content_type===1){if(!v.txt_addr) throw new Error('正文地址缺失'); var text=String(java.cacheFile(v.txt_addr,86400)); var lines=text.split(/\r?\n/); if(c.start_lines<0 || c.end_lines>lines.length || c.end_lines<=c.start_lines) throw new Error('章节边界异常'); return lines.slice(c.start_lines,c.end_lines).join(String.fromCharCode(10));} if(c.content_type===2 && /^https?:/.test(c.content || '')) return ''; throw new Error('不支持的章节类型');})()
